Name: Gardienne Emeraude Animated Levitation Fashion Sense
Author: Juchliate
Description:
Give your farmer a sage-green gown, flowing red ribbons, and a glowing crystal. Gardienne Émeraude hovers gently at rest and glides in all four directions. Her hair, ribbons, and dress trail behind her as she moves. The included Mystic Glide add-on smooths out the default walking bob and replaces her footsteps with three delicate chimes.
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense 7.5.0 or later[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the main download and copy both folders into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. Open the Fashion Sense Hand Mirror and select [b]Outfits → Presets → Gardienne Emeraude[/b].[/*]
[/list][b]Main file description[/b]
Includes the complete Fashion Sense outfit (1.1.0) and the Mystic Glide SMAPI add-on (1.0.4).
[b]Compatibility[/b]
Developed on Windows in single-player with Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2, and Fashion Sense 7.5.0. The character keeps her hovering pose while using tools.
